_about: Faction story arc, beats 1 and 2, from godot/story/outlines.md (issue 1990). Beat 3 is STORY_BEAT3 in campaign_tables.json; the run ending is RUN_ENDING. Shapes: godot/story/arc.gd.
charge: Recover the Lattice's last primary lens from the Hollow Sun before Eclipse bolts it onto a stolen star.
prior_loss: Nobody mentions the earlier voyage that never came home.

A.title: The Mirror-Buoy
text: The black hole ahead used to be Ardent, and your grandmothers polished the collectors that harvested its light before Eclipse killed the star. The Lens-keepers sent you to recover the last intact primary lens before your uploaded siblings seize it, and reminded you twice to bring its gimbal frame too.

On your first jump, an ancient optical buoy rotates toward your flagship and flashes a sharp warning code. {rival} came through first. {rival_deed} The buoy offers to drain its thousand-year core of stored starlight to expose {his} route, though doing so leaves it dark forever. Your cataloger already pulses eager amber.

options.s: Its logs reveal {his} lane: Nemesis clock goes back 1, and the buoy dims permanently.
options.out: The buoy empties its core willingly, and your cataloger marks the entry irreplaceable in muted violet.

options.s: Your captains study its warning angles instead: every captain gains 15 XP.
options.out: The buoy settles back onto its quiet orbit while your cataloger logs two stiff footnotes of protest.

A.title: The Ringing Field
text: Sector II forces your formation across the Ringing Field, a drift of shattered Glasswright hulls from the collapse whose glass fragments still flash blindingly whenever coherent light strikes them. {rival} turned the graveyard into a trap, deliberately cracking wrecks to flood your interferometers with glare.

Your youngest captains, barely a century old, ripple pale grief across their inlays while the cataloger logs every destroyed hull number with shaking focus. Your eldest Mirror flew in this fleet when it was whole; she suggests pulsing one synchronized damping tone across all hulls to quiet the shards, though stopping gives {rival} time to maneuver.

text.t: The buoy's resonance maps which shards {rival} intends to shatter next.
The spared buoy's early warning marked an unmined corridor around the worst debris.

options.s: Your crews steady their focus: every captain gains 20 XP. {He} reads your position clearly: clock moves on 1.
options.out: The fractured hulls absorb the matched frequency and dim one by one as the cataloger records each hull code.

options.l: Cut emissions and burn blind through the glare
options.s: Every ship takes 5% debris damage, yet you catch {him} mid-turn and expose a Nemesis weakness.
options.out: You fly purely on inertial drift through blinding shards, emerging close enough to read {his} shield seams.

options.l: Vent the stored light across the field
options.s: Every shard goes dark instantly: no damage and Nemesis clock back 1, though the light is spent.
options.out: The glare dies in half a second, and your cataloger draws one neat line through the inventory entry.

options.s: Clean transit with no damage and no clock gain: every captain gains 10 XP.
options.out: The unmined lane holds true to the exact arc, and your cataloger adds a rare note of praise.
